title: Neff Drexel
description: neff-drexel.ch zoominfo.com/c/neff--drexel/431534427 Neff & Drexel AG Swiss multimedia retailer and integrator founded in 1967 in Gais (Appenzell) as a family Radio-TV shop — today operating as 1xRichtig ("once, correctly") from Gaiserstrasse 46, Appenzell (AG, UID CHE-105.772.429, capital CHF 100,000 after a June 2026 capital reduction from CHF 400,000). It sells, installs and repairs consumer and professional audio/video tech — home Hi-Fi and home cinema (with room-calibration via its own measurement system), plus pro-AV integration for churches, school halls, swimming pools, restaurants and boardrooms — and retails through the European Expert buying cooperative to match marketplace pricing. Run by Jakob Sutter (board president) and Markus Wetter — a 32-year multimedia veteran and former president of the Swiss radio/TV retailers' association for Eastern Switzerland + Liechtenstein — it's also an accredited apprenticeship company (Multimediaelektroniker EFZ, 4-year program).
